compile_warnings: Existing Arduino core/library warnings; no warning located in current .ino.

host_tests.scope: Actual sketch C++ with mocked hardware; actual inline JS in Node and real Chromium against localhost HTTP to mocked sketch. No USB, Arduino WiFi, or physical actuators accessed.

behavior.mode: shared hold-to-run motor and steering intent

motor_pins.D7: L293D pin2 IN1 HIGH during motor ON

behavior.boot: Motor OFF; servo immediately commanded nominal center. First centering without horn/linkage.
behavior.steer_only: Explicit motor=0; motor OFF even with active steering lease.
behavior.controls: Motor and steering hold independently, both multitouch orders, release turn centers, release drive switches motor off, Center preserves only an already held motor request.
behavior.bound_scope: From browser processing release or communication loss to motor OFF and neutral command; excludes event delivery delay, up to next 20ms servo PWM period and mechanical motion. Timer interrupts must run.
behavior.failure: PWM/timer startup failure prevents control. Servo PWM failure switches motor OFF and servo signal LOW; physical centering not guaranteed.

last_known_uploaded_version.status: Historical upload and user acceptance only; current hardware was not queried during V3 preparation.

read_only_reviews.protocol_ui_isr: Independent agent review: no blocking finding; root inspected actual source and reviewed test evidence.
read_only_reviews.timer_pin_power: Independent audit of installed core1.6.0: motor GPT0A, servo GPT7B, D8 stays GPIO, safety GPT4. No dynamic allocation, waiting or modem calls in PWM duty updates.
read_only_reviews.final_documentation: Independent review confirmed source, reports and logs; ambiguous pending power wording corrected. Actual second USB voltage/current remains unconfirmed.

power.planned: Existing powerbank output 1 to UNO USB-C; output 2 directly to SG90 only after confirming 5 V and current rating. Common GND; AA holder remains motor source.
power.pending: Second USB V/A rating and shared limit plus available cable/breakout to expose +5V/GND.

preview.scope: Screenshot of actual sketch UI served by local mocked C++ test. Separate offline HTML uses the same embedded UI, visible simulation notice, mock fetch and CSP connect-src none.

limitations: Source, compile and simulations are ready; V3 upload and physical commissioning not performed.
SG90 neutral, direction, actual angle, load, startup power and current reserve unmeasured.
Unknown DC motor current, earlier heavy start, battery population and missing decoupling remain hardware concerns.
No claim that CAD fit, printed steering or actual vehicle performance is proven by software tests.
workspace_policy: All new artifacts in personal 3d-print repo; existing CAD/print set untouched, no Desktop, no device control, no commit/push.
